subject: health
unitTitle: Capstone: Personal Health Plan and Community Advocacy
essentialQuestion: What plan would still be running a year from now, and what would I want changed for other people?

prompts.prompt: Explain integrating four years of health learning into one working plan in your own words and give a valid example.
Use a cited source, diagram, model, or documented process to show understanding of stating evidence for each element of the plan.
Apply building in review points and revision triggers in a new fictional situation. Show the decision process or cite the evidence used.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, or unsafe choice involving choosing one advocacy commitment that is realistic; correct it and explain why.

Connect presenting a plan to a guardian without disclosing private detail with defending choices under questioning and revising after critique. Explain how the two support, constrain, or build on one another.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Present the complete personal health plan and advocacy commitment for review, defend each element with evidence and reasoning, then revise it based on the critique received.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy, and one next question.

adaptationChoices: The defense may be spoken, written, presented as annotated slides, or delivered in a one-to-one conversation with an adult. No public presentation, recording, or audience is required.
accommodationNote: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. No assessment requires disclosure, a recording, or any body measurement.
neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
This task never requires calorie counting or a diet or weight-loss goal.
This task never requires disclosing private medical history, a diagnosis, or sexual history.
This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
This task never requires a public performance or an audience.
